principle: Repeatable embodied competency and rugby field transfer, not isolated personal bests.

requirements.consistency: compare completed versus prescribed sessions and documented adaptations; missing evidence is not completion
requirements.workload: consider practice, matches and independent training; do not reward extra volume
requirements.fieldTransfer: coach-observed rugby-specific movement and decision application; gym performance alone insufficient
requirements.retest: available even when consistency insufficient; comparable protocol; educational feedback
requirements.progression: requires consistency, repeatable competency, field transfer, safety and authorized coach review; no single personal best or automatic advancement
requirements.recovery: respect planned taper, rest, injury restrictions and coach-approved modifications

unresolved: approved consistency thresholds and observation windows
